summary.text: Anthony Loubet is a Republican state representative from Utah House of Representatives District 27 who took office on January 1, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Anthony Loubet earned an associate degree from Moorpark College in 2006, a bachelor's degree from California Lutheran University in 2010, and a law degree from Brigham Young University in 2015, according to Ballotpedia.

His career experience includes working as a civil division deputy county attorney in Utah County, as an attorney in private practice, and as a law clerk with state-level district courts and an appellate court.
He succeeded Brady Brammer as the representative for District 27.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Loubet said he started his own law practice, Loubet Law, in 2025, after serving as chief legal officer and general counsel for a company providing services to individuals with disabilities.
He said he has served on the Judiciary Committee, the Government Operations Committee, and two appropriations subcommittees, including as vice chair of General Government Appropriations.
He listed lower property taxes, access to health care options, and resources and investment for West Side communities as areas of focus, and said he has supported legislation to improve air quality.
